recipes.name: spotify_play_song
recipes.description: Search and play a requested song using native Spotify, browser CDP, then screen fallback. Verify playback before claiming success.

steps.expected_observation: Spotify search or playback starts for the requested song.
Native media metadata confirms the song or playback state.

fallback_steps.expected_observation: Browser media state or a Pause button confirms playback.

args.description: visible Spotify play button for the requested result

fallback_steps.expected_observation: Spotify starts playback after the visible play button is clicked.

recipes.done_condition: A native or browser media observation confirms Spotify is playing or the visible UI has changed to pause/playing.

recipes.name: stripe_revenue_check
recipes.description: Check today's Stripe sales or revenue from the current signed-in dashboard. Never handle credentials; ask the user to sign in manually if needed.

steps.expected_observation: Stripe Dashboard is visible, or the user is asked to sign in manually.
Dashboard text includes Today, gross volume, sales, revenue, payments, or a login prompt.
Visible Stripe dashboard text is extracted by browser fallback.

args.prompt: Read the current Stripe dashboard and extract today's sales/revenue/gross volume only if visible. If a login screen is visible, say the user needs to sign in.

steps.expected_observation: Visible dashboard values or login status are summarized.

recipes.done_condition: The answer includes a verified visible value for today's Stripe sales/revenue, or clearly states that sign-in is required.

recipes.name: revenuecat_revenue_check
recipes.description: Check RevenueCat dashboard sales/revenue from the current signed-in account. Never handle credentials; ask the user to sign in manually if needed.

steps.expected_observation: RevenueCat dashboard is visible, or the user is asked to sign in manually.
Dashboard text includes revenue, sales, proceeds, subscriptions, last 28 days, month, or a login prompt.
Visible RevenueCat dashboard text is extracted by browser fallback.

args.prompt: Read the current RevenueCat dashboard and extract this month's sales/revenue if visible. If only a different range is visible, report that exact range and value. If a login screen is visible, say the user needs to sign in.

steps.expected_observation: Visible dashboard values, visible date range, or login status are summarized.

recipes.done_condition: The answer includes a verified visible value and date range for RevenueCat sales/revenue, or clearly states that sign-in or a date filter change is required.

recipes.name: calendar_event_lookup
recipes.description: Find local Calendar events by query and date window with private-data approval.

steps.expected_observation: Matching local Calendar events are returned.

recipes.done_condition: Calendar matches are summarized or no matching event is found.

recipes.name: reminder_creation
recipes.description: Create a local Reminders item with parsed due dates after approval.

steps.expected_observation: A reminder is created and Reminders opens for confirmation.

recipes.done_condition: The reminder exists or Iris reports exactly why creation failed.

recipes.name: gmail_summarize_thread
recipes.description: Search Gmail and summarize visible messages after approval for private email content.

steps.expected_observation: Visible Gmail search results or thread content are summarized.

recipes.done_condition: The requested Gmail content is summarized, or Iris asks the user to sign in/search manually.

recipes.name: github_failing_ci
recipes.description: Inspect a local repo or GitHub page, find failing CI, and summarize next debugging steps.

steps.expected_observation: The repo debugging workflow starts or drafts steps.

recipes.done_condition: Failing checks are identified and a next action is suggested.
